title: Amazon becomes the 2nd US company to join the $1 trillion club
text: Amazon becomes the 2nd US company to join the $1 trillion club Tuesday, 4 September 2018 ( 3 hours ago ) Amazon CEO Jeff Bezos holds up the new Kindle Fire HD 7" and Kindle Fire HD 8.9" (L) during Amazon's Kindle Fire event in Santa Monica, California September 6, 2012. It’s official: Amazon is the second American company to achieve a valuation of more than $1 trillion. Shares of the e-commerce giant gained about 2% in trading Tuesda to hit an all-time high of $2,050.27. Multiplied by the current number of shares outstanding — 487,741,189 — that puts the company’s book value just over the same symbolic milestone...
